a.sub: A side panel, not a popup that vanishes the moment you click away. Paste, pick a recipient, done.
a.panel_message: Meet me at the usual place at 8. Bring the drive.
b.sub: Not just your keys. Your contacts, your settings and your history are sealed under the same master key, and padded, so even their size tells you nothing.
b.foot: Who you talk to is as sensitive as what you say. It gets the same treatment.
b.card_sub: Every store is AES-256-GCM, bound to the slot it lives in. Move a blob between them and it refuses to open.
c.sub: Unlock your keys with a passkey: Touch ID, Windows Hello or a YubiKey. Nothing to type, nothing to forget.
c.foot: Prefer a password? Argon2id at 64 MB is waiting, and it never leaves the sandbox either.
c.sheet_q: Use Touch ID to unlock PGP Tools?
c.sheet_p: Your passkey will derive the key that decrypts your vault. It never leaves this device.
c.lock_title: Locks itself when you stop using it
c.lock_sub: On idle, on close, or after every operation. Your call.
d.sub: If the signature fails, there is nothing to read.
d.message: Meet me at the usual place at 8.
e.sub: You shouldn't have to trust a browser extension with your secrets on faith. Read the source, then decide.
e.foot: No accounts. No telemetry. No content scripts on the pages you visit.
e.row1: Crypto runs in Rust, not JavaScript
e.row1_sub: Sequoia-PGP compiled to WebAssembly. Your key bytes stay inside the sandbox.
e.row2_sub: AES-256-GCM, bound to each key's own fingerprint.
e.row3: Bring the keys you already have
e.row3_sub: Import armored PGP keys, or an SSH key for age encryption.
